## Using this website

This site is designed for keyboard navigation, responsive layouts and readable colour contrast. A “Skip to main content” link appears when focused with the keyboard. Publications remain readable when JavaScript is disabled; JavaScript adds search and filtering controls.

If you encounter a barrier, please email [xiaoxiong.xie@plymouth.ac.uk](mailto:xiaoxiong.xie@plymouth.ac.uk) with the page address and a description of the problem.

## Privacy

This website includes no advertising scripts, contact forms or embedded third-party widgets. Fonts, styles and site-search resources are served with the website. Search and publication filtering run in your browser.

::: {.generated-analytics-privacy}
:::

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Hosting requests are subject to [GitHub’s privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement). Following a link to another website takes you to a service with its own privacy practices.

This is a personal academic website. Official institutional information is available from the [University of Plymouth](https://www.plymouth.ac.uk/staff/xiaoxiong-xie).
